composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Make a short-pile brown bear holding a broad fabric pinwheel close to its chest. Turn one rose-and-teal blade slightly forward, suggesting slow rotation while the bear tilts its head with curious composure. Keep seams visible and hands simple. Soft natural-looking studio light reveals woven cloth against warm cream, with no scattered symbols or toy-store backdrop. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
